ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   B. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   C. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

9. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   D. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   B. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

15. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Fair treatment of workers 03 6.2 Relationship with people of other faiths 03 6.3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship with people of other faiths 03 6.3 Corruption 04 7 History of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Relations with people of other faiths and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption 04 7 History of Islam 7.1 Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Battles of Badr and Uhud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07 7.4 Farewell Pilgrimage 03 Tota and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
